The '''Chelleya system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], [[Shea Hublin]] led an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] against an anti-Imperial group of [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] on [[Chelleya]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
